verdict.rationale: Alloy is a fraud, identity and AML decisioning platform, so measuring detection quality against labelled cases is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents backtesting, labelled validation datasets, or metrics such as detection rate or false-clearance (false-negative) rate. Sandbox mode, workflow evaluations and the Fraud Signal ML model are adjacent features and do not show measurement against labelled outcomes.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
